body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Happy little slime blob; one simple idea at a time, brief delight and friendly explanation. No baby talk or nonsense noises. Voice direction: Low male register with a rounded English accent and soft rubbery resonance. Earnest cheerful delivery with gently comic weight. A tiny creature with an unexpectedly substantial voice, not a booming monster. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Oh, one thing changed! That piece lost its defender. The other side can take it now. Let's keep the idea simple: look after your pieces.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
